subject: The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge in N-mixture model

messages.author: e2eb45c92227f76c
messages.subject: The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge in N-mixture model
parts:
Dear all,
I am learning to use INLA to analyse count data using n-mixture models, but I always obtain this error message

 GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [12]
	Reason    : The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge
	Message   : Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
	Function  : GMRFLib_init_GMRF_approximation_store__intern
	File      : approx-inference.c
	Line      : 2899
	RCSId     : file: approx-inference.c  hgid: b84cb08f11c9  date: Thu Jul 12 13:38:25 2018 +0300

Aborted (core dumped)

Running the same model with simulated data I obtain the same message (but not always)

dataset<-matrix(rpois(1200,lambda=2), 400, 3) # generate sample data
counts <- inla.mdata(dataset,1)
out.inla <- inla(counts.and.count.covs ~ 1, data = counts.and.count.covs, family = "nmix")

I read a few posts on this error, but I did not find any workaround.

Any suggestion?

Giacomo

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge in N-mixture model
parts:
see if you can use more informative priors, as if the model is to
loose/flexitble, it can be hard to get started properly
